content.text: The text surveys nematode parasites, including threadworms, *Leptodera*, hookworm, trichina, Guinea-worm, and filaria, describing anatomy, transmission, symptoms, prevention, and historical treatments. It then discusses liver disorders: biliousness, lithaemia, temporary glycosuria, jaundice, hepatic congestion, perihepatitis, cirrhosis, abscess, acute yellow atrophy, phosphorus poisoning, cancer, amyloid degeneration, fatty liver, and bile-duct catarrh. Emphasis is placed on diet, alcohol, infections, obstruction, portal circulation, diagnostic signs, prognosis, and largely historical therapies. John travelled to the office.
